visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Two Asian men in beige shirts stand outside a subway entrance (Zhongxiao Fuxing). One creator points towards the station, speaking with high energy. The background shows urban architecture and a red bus passing by. The lighting is natural daylight. (2) Inside the subway station, the creators walk and talk, clapping their hands in excitement. They are moving towards a specific destination. The environment is a clean, modern station concourse with bright artificial lighting. Passersby are visible in the background. (3) On an escalator, the creators converse while gesturing upwards. A female manager is interviewed, looking emotional with her hands on her chest. The camera captures her close-up against the backdrop of subway advertisements and the station interior. (4) A massive billboard is revealed, featuring the two creators' faces and a product. They walk towards it, expressing shock and amazement. The billboard occupies a large wall in the station, with high-contrast commercial lighting highlighting the brand FUTURE SALAD. (5) The creators interact with fans and their father in front of the billboard. One man hugs his father, who wears a red shirt and a black cap. They take group photos and selfies, with the large ad as the background. (6) One creator holds a smartphone for a video call, showing the billboard to his mother. The phone screen displays the mother's face. They are standing in a corridor of the subway station near the ad display. (7) Final shot in front of the billboard. The creators give thumbs up, high-five, and thank the audience. The composition is a medium shot capturing their joyful expressions and the primary product imagery on the wall behind them.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Energetic male voices speak in Traditional Chinese with high pitch variability and arousal. Uplifting acoustic guitar music starts immediately, setting a positive tone. Subtle urban background noise like traffic and distant chatter is present but low in intensity. (2) Hard cut to station interior. The vocal reverb increases slightly, indicating a larger indoor space. Laughter and rhythmic hand clapping are audible over the continuous acoustic BGM. Short transition whoosh SFX occurs between scene shifts. (3) Pitch of the male voices rises significantly as they express awe (Wow, Oh my god). A female voice enters with an emotional, slightly tremulous tone. The BGM remains steady with a moderate tempo and major-key tonality. (4) Incidental noises like footsteps on the station floor and the rustle of clothes are heard. A fan's voice is heard praising the creators. The acoustic guitar continues with a bright, clean spectral brightness and percussive strumming. (5) A new male voice (the father) speaks with a warm, lower-pitched tone. The sound of a video call ringtone and digital UI notification SFX occurs as they call their mother. The mother's voice is heard through a compressed phone speaker. (6) Final sequence features high-energy vocal delivery as creators thank their fans and the brand. BGM swells in volume before a clean fade-out. The signal-to-noise ratio remains high, ensuring clear speech intelligibility throughout the excitement.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To share and celebrate a major milestone in the creators' career—appearing on a massive billboard at a prominent metro station—while expressing gratitude to their fans and the sponsoring brand.
